name: Eguchi Eiji
source:
Eiji is Kaho's husband and works at an office. He knows of the beauty of his wife and his kinda jealous therefore he doesn't want that she works in places where she is exposed to too much young men.

Lately due to an incident at his workplace he has to work overtime and take a significant pay-cut.
